artifact_delivered: Deep Q-Network (DQN) — neural network function approximation for Q-learning on CartPole
workstream_summary: C531: Built DQN agent with neural network Q-function, experience replay, and target network. Compared to tabular Q-learning baseline on CartPole. DQN (2-layer MLP, 64 hidden) learned from 14→47 avg reward over 1000 episodes, clearly outperforming tabular baseline (10→16). Key insight: function approximation enables RL in continuous state spaces without discretization. Experience replay breaks temporal correlation for i.i.d. SGD samples. Target network stabilizes bootstrapping by decoupling Q-target from Q-predicate. Fixed critical bug: gradient double-scaling (divided by batch_size in both grad_output and backward) prevented learning entirely.
